story_text:
## What Makes AURA 3 Max the Best
## Awards & Recognition
## Reviewed By
## World's First 4K 120Hz UST Projector
## Fast Action Stays Crisp
Powered by dual TI DLPC display controllers, AURA 3 Series delivers 4K UHD at 120Hz, keeping fast-moving scenes sharp and fluid with reduced motion blur and clearer moving detail. From sports and action scenes to gameplay, every frame stays crisp.
## RBE, Singificantly Reduced
With a higher 120Hz refresh rate, colors cycle faster to help reduce visible rainbow effects. Combined with AURA 3 Series’s Anti-RBE technology, it delivers cleaner, more natural visuals across both 2D and 3D content.
## Global MEMC - Clear & Smooth Motion
4K 120Hz Global MEMC intelligently smooths motion across the entire screen, reducing judder and motion blur while preserving image detail. From fast-paced sports to action-packed scenes, every movement stays smooth and clear.
## Native 24fps
Watch films exactly as intended—120Hz is an exact multiple of 24fps, displaying each cinematic frame five times in a consistent 5:5 cadence, without 3:2 pulldown judder.
## Dual Iris - A First in UST Projection
## 8000:1 Native Contrast
Up to 8,000:1 native contrast for deeper black perception in large-screen projection — enabled by precision light control at the source.
## 5-step Manual Iris Control
Two irises work together to refine every beam of light.
## Dynamic Iris Frame-by-Frame Precision
Automatically adjusting the iris size based on scene brightness for optimal contrast and brightness.
## Advanced DBLE
Our advanced DBLE technology boosts dynamic contrast by up to 10× while preserving shadow detail and true-to-life color.
## 5700 ISO Lumens
RGB triple laser delivers a clear image in bright rooms for anytime viewing.
## 3D Depth You Can Feel
Natural dimensionality brings cinematic realism into your living space.
## HDR As It Should Be
Deeper blacks, brighter highlights, and richer colors across all major HDR formats.
## Accurate, Vivid Color Quality
RGB Triple Laser maintains accurate, vivid color quality — even at peak brightness.
## X-VISION AI Image Processor
Powered by XGIMI-developed X-VISION AI image processor, AURA 3 Series intelligently optimizes every frame in real time for sharper detail, richer contrast, and a more lifelike picture.
## AI Detail Reconstruction
X-VISION intelligently reconstructs every frame in real time, restoring texture, refining edges, and bringing hidden details back into view.
## Dynamic HDR Optimization
X-VISION analyzes every HDR scene in real time, dynamically optimizing brightness and contrast for brighter highlights, deeper shadows, and richer depth.
## Google TV Built Right In
Enjoy instant access to Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, and more — no extra devices needed. Control your content effortlessly with Google Home and voice commands.
## Harman Kardon Sound That Fills the Room
80W of room-filling sound with remarkable clarity and depth.
## Extensive Connection Options
## 120" Projection from Just 8 Inches Away
## Quiet Enough <28dB @ 1m
Hear the movie, not the machine. AURA 3 Series keeps fan noise low, so you can stay immersed in movies, games, and music without distraction.
Everything you need for a more responsive, immersive big-screen gaming experience.
Experience ultra-smooth 4K 120Hz gameplay with reduced motion blur, keeping fast action sharp and responsive.
VRR & AMD FreeSync™ deliver smooth, tear-free gaming with fluid frames and ultra-low latency.
Experience deeper contrast, lifelike colors, and enhanced shadow detail with Dolby Vision Gaming technology.
## Precision Optical Engine™ for UST
While other UST projectors lose image clarity at the edges, AURA 3 Series maintains full-frame sharpness and color consistency.
## ED-Grade Optical Glass
Minimizes chromatic distortion — even at extreme projection angles.
## Ultra-Broadband Coating
Maximizes light transmission while reducing reflection, providing higher brightness and improved image depth.
## 19-Element Optical System
A precision-engineered optical stack ensures uniform sharpness across the entire screen.
## Not Just a Projector - a Centerpiece
AURA 3 Series feels at home in every home — designed to be displayed, not hidden.
## One-Click Automation for Hassle-Free Setup
## What's in the Box
## Specifications
Every AURA 3 model delivers the same flagship DNA—choose the brightness & contrast level that's right for your space.
## XGIMI Ascend UST - Floor-Rising Screen with Speakers
A cinematic big-screen experience without a permanent black screen on your wall.
Ascend syncs with your AURA 3, powering on and off together as the screen rises for viewing and retracts neatly into its base when you’re done.
*Screen shown in the TVC may differ from the mass production version. Refer to actual product and official renders.
From 75" to 120", Ascend takes big-screen viewing to another scale.
No wall mounting. No holes. Just place Ascend where you want your screen.
A black-grid CLR surface rejects ambient light from above while directing projected light toward the viewer.
The 8-driver, 170W Harman Kardon audio system delivers deep bass, clear dialogue and immersive Dolby Atmos® sound — without the need for external speakers.
## Product Size - Ascend
## XGIMI 120"-150" UST Fresnel ALR Screen
Designed specifically for UST projection, the Fresnel structure directs light toward the viewer while rejecting ambient light from above and the sides for a brighter, clearer image with enhanced contrast.
See richer colors, stronger contrast and clearer detail — even when the room isn't completely dark.
Enjoy a clean, glare-free view with a premium matte surface that minimizes reflections for more comfortable viewing, even in bright environments.
## Product Size - Fresnel ALR Screen
## Timeline
## Shipping & Taxes
We will use a transparent two-step payment process to ensure accuracy and help prevent unexpected “hidden fees” at the doorstep for the majority of our backers:
- Kickstarter Payment: Kickstarter will process your reward pledge immediately after the campaign ends.
- Post-Campaign Survey: Shortly after the campaign ends, you will receive a survey email via our official partner. For backers from the countries and regions with clearly listed rates in the table below, the corresponding Sales Tax/VAT will be collected through the Post-Campaign Survey. Once you provide your shipping address, the system will calculate the precise Sales Tax/VAT for your location.
- For countries and regions where a specific rate is not listed in the table below, backers may need to cooperate with the courier to complete customs clearance and handle any applicable local taxes, duties, or related fees upon delivery.
Important Notes:
- "Covered": XGIMI pays these fees on your behalf. No extra payment is needed for these items.
- Pledge-Based Taxation: Taxes are calculated based on your net payment for the reward (as recorded in the final backer report 10 business days post-campaign), not the retail price.
## About XGIMI
Founded in 2013, XGIMI began with a singular mission: to redefine home entertainment through intelligent, all-in-one projection technology. Over the past decade, we have evolved from an industry pioneer into a global leader, blending award-winning design with breakthrough optics to bring the theater experience home.
## A Decade of Leadership
Today, XGIMI connects with millions of users across 100+ countries. For two consecutive years, we have maintained our position as the No. 1 brand in the global home projector market, with over 7 million units sold worldwide. Our success is built on a foundation of 6,000+ retail touchpoints and a steadfast commitment to innovation.
## Mastering Quality Through Self-Reliance
We believe true quality is mastered through independence. By establishing our own full-link R&D and smart manufacturing hubs, we control every stage of production—from lens fabrication to optical engine assembly. This pioneering spirit allows us to push the boundaries of light and contrast, ensuring every XGIMI projector lights up family moments with unparalleled clarity.
## Connect with XGIMI
risks: 1. Supply Chain & Manufacturing AURA 3's precision optics and Dual Iris Technology require careful, high-precision manufacturing. Component delays are always a risk, but our established supplier relationships and manufacturing infrastructure help us stay on track and maintain quality. 2. Global Logistics International shipping means navigating customs and freight across many regions. We've partnered with fulfillment specialists experienced in crowdfunding to keep deliveries smooth, with clear tracking and updates along the way. 3. Commitment to Transparency We'll keep our community informed at every step. If challenges come up in production or shipping, we'll share honest updates and revised timelines right away.

faq.q: Why did I see a disclaimer on the campaign page that said “Rewards are not guaranteed”?
faq.a: Kickstarter requires this disclaimer for all projects. However, please rest assured that the XGIMI team is fully prepared. Our supply chain and manufacturing partners are ready to go. We are committed to 100% delivery for every purchased reward and will keep you updated every step of the way.

To pledge to our campaign, please refer to Kickstarter’s official guide:
https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005066393-How-do-I-pledge
For other pledge-related questions, please also refer to:
https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005126434-Common-Pledge-Problems

faq.q: How can I modify my pledge?
faq.a:
While a project is live, you can adjust your pledge by visiting the project page and clicking the “Manage Your Pledge” button. On the following page, select “Change Your Pledge” to modify your pledge details. For more information, please refer to Kickstarter’s guide:
https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005126814-How-can-I-change-my-pledge-amount-or-reward-selection-

faq.q: It’s my first time pledging on Kickstarter. How do I know if my pledge went through?
faq.a: After backing our project, Kickstarter will send you a confirmation email right away. You’ll also receive a Kickstarter inbox message to confirm that your pledge was successful. Please note that you won’t be charged until the campaign ends, and we will collect your shipping details after the campaign through a post-campaign survey. If you need help confirming your pledge, feel free to send us a direct message on Kickstarter or contact us at aura3@xgimi.com.

faq.q: When does my card get charged? Can I cancel the pledge?
faq.a: Your card will be charged when the campaign ends, and you can cancel your pledge at any time before then.

faq.q: Kickstarter email does not match my reservation email. What should I do?
faq.a: Your Kickstarter account email must exactly match the email used during the reservation. Otherwise, you may not be able to claim the early-bird discounts and deposit refund benefits. If you need further assistance, feel free to send us a direct message on Kickstarter or contact us at aura3@xgimi.com.

faq.q: Is the deposit for the reservation refundable?
faq.a: Yes, the $50 deposit is fully refundable. To qualify for the exclusive Super Early Bird pricing and extra savings, we recommend keeping your reservation active while you pledge on Kickstarter. Within 10 business days after the campaign concludes, our team will process your $50 deposit refund and any applicable partial refunds for your extra savings. If you decide not to proceed and would like your deposit refunded earlier, please send us a direct message on Kickstarter or contact us at aura3@xgi…

faq.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a:
Payment options are provided through Kickstarter. For detailed information about accepted payment methods, please refer to Kickstarter’s official guide:
https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005066433-What-forms-of-payment-can-I-use-to-make-a-pledge

faq.q: How and when will I pay for shipping and taxes?
faq.a: We use a two-step payment process. First, Kickstarter will process your reward pledge and applicable shipping fees after the campaign ends. Shortly afterward, you will receive a post-campaign survey through our official partner. Once you provide your shipping address, the applicable Sales Tax or VAT will be calculated based on your location.

faq.q: How is the shipping sequence determined?
faq.a: Shipping priority is determined by your Kickstarter Backer Number. Your Backer Number is assigned based on when your pledge is completed. The earlier you pledge after the campaign goes live, the lower your Backer Number will be. We will fulfill rewards in numerical order so our earliest supporters receive their projectors first.
At this time, we do not. Since the project is hosted on Kickstarter and we aim to begin shipping as soon as the campaign concludes, payments are processed as a single transaction.
We plan to start the address confirmation process around mid December, 2026. Shipping will then proceed based on Backer Number order.

faq.q: How do I provide my shipping address and reward details?
faq.a:
We will send you a post-campaign survey by email after the project ends to collect your shipping address and other fulfillment information. We will also post an Update with further instructions before the campaign concludes. Once you complete the survey, you’ll receive an email confirmation with a copy of your responses. For more information, please refer to Kickstarter’s guide:
https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005126894-How-do-I-provide-a-creator-with-my-shipping-address-and-re…

faq.q: Is the product price the same for all countries?
faq.a: Yes, the pledge price is uniform globally. However, shipping fees, Sales Tax, and customs fees are calculated separately based on your specific region and local regulations.

faq.q: What about VAT for EU customers?
faq.a: The final product price excludes VAT. VAT for EU customers will be calculated and paid separately according to the tax regulations of the destination country. Please refer to the “Shipping & Taxes” section on our campaign page for detailed information.
